question: In October 2018, Indian scientists developed a gel called _____ to protect farmers from toxic pesticides.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Poly-Oxime**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In October 2018,** Indian scientists developed a gel called poly-Oxime to protect farmers from toxic pesticides.**
 
• Researchers **at the Institute for Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine (InStem) in Bangalore, India.**
 
• The gel breaks down toxic chemicals into safe substances, preventing them from going deep into the skin and organs
 
• It is **made from chemically modified chitosan, which is found in the shells of crustaceans like crabs, lobsters, and shrimps**
 
• In **studies on rats**, the gel prevented the loss of motor coordination, loss of endurance, and altered neuromuscular signaling

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Farmers are exposed to toxic pesticides, through skin contact and inhalation, during the spraying of pesticides.
 
• This skin gel inhibits the absorption of the most commonly used pesticides that can cause serious ill effects on health.
 
• The Institute for Stem Cell Biology and Regenerative Medicine (inStem), is a state-of-the-art research institute in Bangalore, India, dedicated to the study of stem cell and regenerative biology.
 
 
• An autonomous institute funded by the Dept of Biotechnology, Govt. of India, inStem emphasizes collaborative research in stem cell biology.
